tools.description: Optional check before you say a C/C++ change works: builds only the test programs the change since the session started reaches, with the project's own build system (CMake: incrementally, in a tree of its own outside the project; otherwise the existing build), runs exactly those tests and compares failures with the unmodified tree, within 90 seconds. The answer names the targets built, the test filter and `git diff --check`. Advisory: it answers PASS, FAIL or NOT RUN (with the reason) and the details, and never blocks finishing; it does not edit or delete any file. Report what it checked and what is still unverified. It runs the project's build, so it needs a trusted project.
tools.name: cpp_finish_check
